info.name: Mandir Setu — User App API
info.description:
Customer-facing (devotee) mobile app endpoints only. See USER_APP_API_SPEC.yaml in the same folder for full field docs.

Auth: run 'Login' first — it auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken into collection variables. Every other request sends {{accessToken}} as a Bearer header automatically. When accessToken expires (30 min), run 'Refresh Token' to get a new pair — it auto-saves them too.
